name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.222: A worker row may not claim work the run did not do. The Download row stored
    "20 downloaded, 22 unavailable, 1 skipped" while carrying DryRun=1, and the run's own log
    line said "20 would have saved" - DescribeDirectionRun took the summaries but never the
    mode. The label now follows the log's words ("would have saved" / "would have uploaded");
    the counters are untouched, because a dry run's numbers are honest about what it FOUND.
